Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning compliance with inspections of child care facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to compliance with inspections of child carefacilities; and adding a new section to chapter 43.215 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.215 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Before requiring any alterations to a child care facility dueto inconsistencies with requirements in chapter 19.27 RCW, thedepartment shall: (a) Consult with the city or county enforcement official; and (b) Receive written verification from the city or countyenforcement official that the alteration is required. (2) The department's consultation with the city or countyenforcement official is limited to licensed child care space. (3) Unless there is imminent danger to children or staff, thedepartment may not modify, suspend, or revoke a child care license orbusiness activities while the department is waiting to: (a) Consult with the city or county enforcement official undersubsection (1)(a) of this section; or p. 1 ESHB 2191 (b) Receive written verification from the city or countyenforcement official that the alteration is required under subsection(1)(b) of this section. (4) For the purposes of this section, "child care facility" meansa family day care home, schoolage care, and child day care center.
